plugins.name: saas-builder
plugins.description: Build and launch a SaaS app: set up login, database, payments, email, file storage and analytics, secure the API, add legal pages, test, deploy, and launch.

plugins.name: dev-core
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic engineering habits: make architecture decisions, debug and fix code safely, review and refactor, test well, and keep commits, docs and changelogs current.

plugins.name: dev-frontend
plugins.description: Frontend work: build and test UI in the browser with Playwright, and implement polished frontend designs.

plugins.name: dev-backend
plugins.description: Backend and ops: deploy and operate infrastructure, run safe migrations, pre-deploy checklists, and incident response.

plugins.name: saas-research
plugins.description: Find problem gaps worth solving: mine Reddit and reviews for real pain, check search demand, and confirm people already pay for solutions.

plugins.name: resume
plugins.description: Land a job: research the company and role, tailor resumes and cover letters to each application, answer selection criteria and forms, polish LinkedIn and portfolios, prep for interviews and negotiate salary.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Write marketing that gets remembered and converts: positioning and brand messaging (StoryBrand, Obviously Awesome), SEO, copy and headlines, persuasion, sticky stories, storyboards and video scripts.

plugins.name: product-manager
plugins.description: Turn ideas into shipped product: run a gated workflow from brief to PRD, flows, stories, tech spec and release plan, plan work into tickets, log decisions, and triage requests.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: General thinking and productivity help: brainstorm, research a topic, make a plan, define scope, stress-test an idea, get unstuck, build habits, shrink big decisions, summarize long material, hand off work between sessions, and build new Claude skills.

plugins.name: savepoint
plugins.description: Save game for work: snapshot a session, load it to resume, list saves, park unrelated work as a Trello card, and autosave as the session grows.

plugins.name: startup-strategy
plugins.description: Figure out a startup's strategy: validate the problem with customers, choose and balance acquisition channels (CAC, LTV, payback), set pricing and business model, find traction, and diagnose why growth is stalling.

plugins.name: ux-design
plugins.description: Design user experiences: generate and refine solution ideas, plan prototypes, critique interfaces, and turn design challenges into concepts and visual designs.

plugins.name: ux-research
plugins.description: Understand users before building: plan and run research (interviews, surveys, usability tests), recruit participants, synthesize findings into personas, journeys and insights, and share recommendations.

plugins.name: writer
plugins.description: Write in your own voice: save a style profile, remove AI-sounding patterns, improve drafts, and summarize or TL;DR long text.
